findings.reason: Standalone original-resolution flagged PNG shows literal begin/node/draw/end source instead of the trellis. The tilde fence bypasses the renderer diagram extractor. Replacing only its delimiters yields an actual compiled trellis.
findings.action: Replaced opening and closing tilde fences with triple-backtick fences; retained every TikZ command.

correction: Two fence delimiters changed. All title, frontmatter, mathematical prose, verification steps, and TikZ drawing commands are unchanged.

diagram_math_checks.data: Layers V1={s}, V2={a,b,c}, V3={t}; initial alpha(s)=1 and terminal beta(t)=1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Example and finite weighted trellis definition: each directed edge runs from one layer to the next. Fresh figure has exactly five vertices arranged in these columns.

diagram_math_checks.data: Exactly five directed edges: s→a and s→b have weight 2; a→t and b→t have weight 3; c→t has weight 100.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Each original draw command matches one explicit Example edge. Fresh original-resolution figure shows all five arrows and labels, with no extra incoming arrow at dashed c.

diagram_math_checks.data: The only admissible full paths are (s,a,t) and (s,b,t), both with score 1·2·3·1=6. No path reaches c.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Verification 1.1 independently enumerates paths from the explicit edge list. The absence of an edge into c gives D2(c)=0, so the outgoing weight 100 cannot create a positive prefix.

diagram_math_checks.data: D2(a)=D2(b)=2, D2(c)=0, D3(t)=max(6,6,0)=6; the supplied a<b<c order selects a on the tie, yielding (s,a,t).
diagram_math_checks.justification: Algorithm Definition step 1 stores the first maximizing predecessor only for positive values; Verification 2.1 applies exactly that convention. Neither the drawing nor its dashed style is used as a proof premise.

native_compile_visual.visual_review: Fresh standalone original-resolution PNG inspected: five vertices, five directed edges and all five weight labels are visible and legible; dashed c is distinct; no concrete overlap or clipping. Proof and Facts render normally.
